entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6491"/><div sID="gen9948" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6491"/>10. God's promises of "mercy" will be verified by His "truth" (compare <reference osisRef="Ps.25.10">Psa 25:10</reference>; <reference osisRef="Ps.40.10">40:10</reference>); and the "work of righteousness" in His holy government shall be "peace" (<reference osisRef="Isa.32.17">Is 32:17</reference>). There is an implied contrast with a dispensation under which God's truth sustains His threatened wrath, and His righteousness inflicts misery on the wicked. <div eID="gen9948" type="x-p"/>
